item.text: I’m checking the project memory for recorded items marked `deprecated`, then I’ll list their titles exactly.

arguments.query: recorded items lifecycle status deprecated title deprecated
recorded items lifecycle status deprecated title deprecated

content.text:
Top 5 recorded entries:

# Trezor facade skip

Lifecycle status: deprecated

CodeGraph skips the trezor connect-common/factory facade because it is low-value: it has a single call fan-in and does not disambiguate per-method targets. Evidence: docs/design/dispatch-synthesizer-backlog.md#2 Immediate next actions says the facade remains low-value and should be skipped.

# RxJS subscribe deferral

Lifecycle status: deprecated

CodeGraph deliberately does not build an RxJS subscribe synthesizer because observable-to-observer flow is predominantly anonymous closures with no stable static name to seed. Evidence: docs/design/dispatch-synthesizer-backlog.md#1 Tier C lists RxJS subscribe under frontier do-not-build and says the playbook keeps it deferred.

# Dispatch resolution deferral

Lifecycle status: deprecated

Function-as-value dispatch resolution remains deliberately uncovered while only the deterministic registration side ships. Evidence: docs/design/function-ref-capture.md#0 Non-goal says resolving `o->cb(x)` needs data-flow through struct fields, partial coverage is worse than none, wrong edges are worse than silence, and dispatch resolution stays uncovered.

# Redux-Saga deferral

Lifecycle status: deprecated

CodeGraph deliberately does not build Redux-Saga synthesis yet because generator-body `yield put()` and `takeEvery(ACTION, saga*)` dispatch is materially harder and should be revisited only when a real repository demands it. Evidence: docs/design/dispatch-synthesizer-backlog.md#1 Tier C lists Redux-Saga under frontier do-not-build with that rationale.

# Skip Luau chained calls

Lifecycle status: deprecated

Luau chained-call support was evaluated and intentionally not shipped because real Luau rarely annotates factory returns, producing +0 on both Fusion and matter despite synthetic support. Evidence: docs/design/chained-call-resolution.md#0 Coverage and Full README classification classify Luau as evaluated and skipped because gradual typing makes the mechanism low-yield.

content.text:
Top 5 recorded entries:

# Entry-node skeletonization gate

Lifecycle status: accepted

Using entry-node membership as the skeletonization gate fails for precise symbol-bag explore queries because every chain participant is named and therefore treated as an entry node. Evidence: docs/design/adaptive-explore-sizing.md#1 Dead ends item 2 says this leaves no separation and nothing skeletonizes.

# Gate needs separable candidates

Lifecycle status: accepted

A skeletonization gate must distinguish named flow participants from collapsible candidates; entry-node membership is not separable for precise symbol-bag queries because those queries name every chain participant. Evidence: docs/design/adaptive-explore-sizing.md#1 Dead ends item 2 says gating on entry-node membership leaves no separation and nothing skeletonizes.

# Value-ref false-positive handling

Lifecycle status: accepted

During value-reference validation, false-positive clusters must be fixed while isolated singletons are recorded as known residuals. Evidence: docs/design/value-reference-edges-playbook.md#0 §0 instructs agents to hunt FPs during the validation sweep, fix FP clusters, and record singletons.

# opencode XDG config path

Lifecycle status: accepted

CodeGraph installs opencode's global MCP entry in the cross-platform opencode config location `~/.config/opencode/`, honoring `XDG_CONFIG_HOME`, instead of the Windows `%APPDATA%\opencode\` path opencode does not read. Evidence: CHANGELOG.md#5 opencode Windows bullet.

# Trezor facade skip

Lifecycle status: deprecated
